data.title: 中野一花 · 微风阳台的深夜私语
data.description: 深夜公寓露台上夜风拂过丝绸睡衣，一花两手交叠搭在栏杆上。身旁是璀璨的城市夜景，她转头投来缱绻深情的目光。
data.action: leaning on balcony railing, head tilted, affectionate gaze
data.lighting: cool blue moonlight and distant city lights
data.promptProse: On a tranquil high-rise balcony at midnight, Nakano Ichika leans against the metal railing wearing a blush pink silk negligee. The moonlight softly touches her shoulders and bare feet as she glances back with a tender, deeply affectionate gaze.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against the balcony railing over city lights, she turns with an intimate moonlit gaze.
